decisions.reason: As a large bulk container, this product fits the firm's established plastics and industrial packaging knowledge base closely, so management is likely to retain it and use early market feedback to refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.

The bulk-container valve is even more tightly related to the firm's existing component and packaging capabilities, making it a strong candidate to keep while the firm learns from initial sales and customer use.

A used packaging take-back service is strategically relevant in Germany's circular-economy context but is less central to the firm's core manufacturing know-how, so it faces a higher risk of withdrawal even though the firm is still more likely to continue and develop it through partnerships.
